teachingSequence: Independent SimCity recording establishes the many-window city context; not hidden-geometry evidence.
Own Unity implementation shows a flat window rendering room depth.
Observer camera reveals the flat geometry and camera-to-pixel ray.
Nearest virtual-wall intersection selects the texture colour.
Same-camera photo/mapping comparison exposes view dependence.
Per-pixel repetition, flat-furniture limit and modelling-cost conclusion.
